conventions.ground: Ground plane is Y=0. North = screen-up (-Z, away from camera), East = screen-right (+X), South = toward camera (+Z).
conventions.asset_front: Assets face +Z (South, toward the camera) at yaw 0, feet on Y=0, pivot at the origin.
conventions.direction_yaw: Direction yaw rotates the asset about +Y; 0=S, 90=E, 180=N, 270=W (right-handed, +Z toward +X). 8 directions decided 2026-09-30 (diagonal movement).
conventions.light_azimuth: Compass azimuth the light comes FROM, clockwise from North (screen-up). 135 = from South-East (lower-right, camera side). Decided 2026-09-30; the in-engine sun must be matched to this once the arena exists.
